title: Walking and running
description: In the tutorial, the player walks left off a pillar at 3 pixels a step and drops to the ledge below. Then, as the sign says "TO RUN, HOLD DOWN X OR SHIFT.", he runs left at 6 pixels a step off the ledge's end and jumps, keeping that speed across the gap to the next ledge.
